# Dental Home – Dental & Maxillofacial Centre

> Dental Home is a dental and maxillofacial clinic in Kakadeo, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India, led by Dr. Ankur Rathaur (BDS, MDS, Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon). The clinic offers general dentistry, dental implants, root canal treatment, smile designing, braces & aligners, wisdom tooth removal, maxillofacial surgery, oral cancer screening, full mouth rehabilitation, and cosmetic dentistry.

Dental Home has a 4.4★ Google rating from 36+ reviews and 6+ years of experience under Dr. Ankur Rathaur, a graduate of Maulana Azad Medical College (MAMC), Delhi. The clinic is open every day from 10:00 AM–2:00 PM and 5:00 PM–9:00 PM, and serves patients from Kakadeo, Kalyanpur, Swaroop Nagar, Govind Nagar, Kidwai Nagar, Vikas Nagar, Shastri Nagar, Yashoda Nagar, Arya Nagar, Naubasta, Civil Lines, and Rawatpur.

## Services Offered

- Dental Implants – permanent titanium implants for missing teeth
- Root Canal Treatment – painless, single-sitting rotary endodontics
- Smile Designing – veneers, contouring, and whitening combined
- Teeth Whitening – in-clinic professional whitening
- Braces & Aligners – metal braces and clear aligners for all ages
- Wisdom Tooth Removal – surgical and simple extractions
- Maxillofacial Surgery – jaw, face, and oral surgical care, including facial trauma and reconstruction
- Oral Cancer Screening & Treatment – early detection of oral cancer and pre-cancerous lesions
- Full Mouth Rehabilitation – implants, crowns, and bridges combined
- Cosmetic Dentistry – smile enhancement treatments
- General Dentistry – check-ups, scaling, polishing, fillings
- Emergency Dental Care – same-day appointments for pain, injury, or breakage

## Areas Served

Kakadeo, Kalyanpur, Swaroop Nagar, Govind Nagar, Kidwai Nagar, Vikas Nagar, Shastri Nagar, Yashoda Nagar, Arya Nagar, Naubasta, Civil Lines, Rawatpur, and surrounding central and south Kanpur localities.
